notes.title: Added special effects to weapon attacks.
notes.content:
1. Optimized the attack determination algorithm to fix the bug where attacks could not hit targets.
2. Added special effects to weapon attacks.

notes.title: Three new kill mode levels are added, which appear randomly
notes.content:
1. The default mode is changed from moba to kill mode
2. Three new kill mode levels are added, which appear randomly
3. Fine-tuning of skills

notes.title: Optimize the sound effects of attacks
notes.content:
1. Optimize the sound effects of attacks
2. Fix the bug that caused the dialogue to skip quickly
3. Fix the bug that caused the right mouse button to not hold the shield for a long time

notes.title: Objects in the scene can be destroyed
notes.content:
1. Memory is greatly optimized
2. Objects in the scene can be destroyed
